reasoning: This Phase 2 trial was terminated due to insufficient enrollment after recruiting only 15 patients over 24 months, preventing any meaningful assessment of the mechanistic causal chain. The trial was designed to test TTFields (tumor treating fields) combined with pembrolizumab in first-line advanced NSCLC. While the dosing regimen was specified (TTFields ≥18 hours daily at 150 kHz, pembrolizumab 200mg q3w), no efficacy, biomarker, or target engagement data were collected due to early termination. The investigator noted this was not due to safety concerns and that a new Phase 3 study was being initiated, suggesting the mechanism remains viable but this specific trial failed due to operational issues rather than scientific reasons.
